expected.fmt:
import (
	stderr, stdout_bytes from "@std/io/io.ms",
	RunOptions, run from "@std/os/process.ms",
	expect_equal from "@std/test/test.ms",
)

fn exercise() Int!:
	match run(
		program: "/bin/printf",
		arguments: ["hello"],
		RunOptions(
			input: "".to_bytes(),
			max_output_bytes: 64,
			timeout: 1.seconds(),
		),
	).wait():
		error(_):
			return ok(1)
		ok(output):
			output.exit_code | try expect_equal(0)

			_ := stdout_bytes().write(value: output.stdout)
			return ok(0)

export fn main() Int:
	match exercise():
		ok(status): return status
		error(cause):
			_written := stderr().write("{cause.message}\n")
			return 1
